rows.reasoning: Ortiz co-sponsored HB 2721 (2024) and voted Y on House Final Reading; the law requires large municipalities to permit duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and townhomes as "a permitted use" and bars them from more restrictive permitting, floor-area ratio or parking rules. Removing local zoning limits is on-question for "Rely on the market to set prices and supply — at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building", but it cannot establish that rung's "at most" ceiling: someone who also wants "binding rules on the private market like rent caps or required affordable units", or "subsidies and tax breaks so more affordable housing gets built", can vote for the same deregulation bill. Nothing in the three sources speaks to public housing, rent rules or subsidies, so the evidence shows a side and not a rung.
